ai_summary: This document from Aartech Solonics Limited is a routine regulatory filing announcing key dates for its upcoming 44th Annual General Meeting (AGM). The company has set September 22, 2026, as the Record Date for determining shareholder eligibility for the final dividend for FY 2025-26 and for e-voting at the AGM. This is a standard corporate compliance update, and no material red flags are present.
